sources.title: Cadre AI | AI Strategy & Implementation for Business Growth & EBITDA Improvement
claimsReviewed: Cadre describes itself as an integrated AI strategy and implementation partner.
Primary outcomes are driving revenue, increasing profitability, and elevating employees.
The home page presents AI Strategy, AI Leadership & Facilitation, AI Engineering, and AI Agents as core service areas.

sources.title: About Us | Cadre AI
claimsReviewed: Cadre states that it has delivered 100+ high-ROI use cases across 50+ companies.
Cadre publishes four cultural values: Growth Mindset, Extreme Ownership, Team First, and Scrappy.
The site describes a centralized portal for tracking tools, agents, training, and results.

sources.title: AI Strategy & Transformation | Cadre AI
claimsReviewed: Cadre advertises a structured 45-day AI Transformation Intensive.
Its strategic approach is Discover Use Cases, Survey the Landscape, Implement Solutions, then Scale with Confidence.
Cadre publishes an eight-pillar AI transformation framework.

sources.title: AI Engineering Services | Cadre AI
claimsReviewed: AI engineering is positioned around solving business problems with existing tools, automation, integrations, and custom AI where appropriate.
Public engineering messaging emphasizes fit-for-purpose model selection and data-security controls.

sources.title: Custom AI Agents for Every Team | Cadre AI
claimsReviewed: Cadre offers custom AI agent work across business teams and workflows.
Agent readiness is framed around process clarity, system access, monitoring, and iteration.

sources.title: AI Leadership & Facilitation | Cadre AI
claimsReviewed: Leadership and facilitation work focuses on executive/team enablement, adoption, and change management.

sources.title: Industries We've Transformed with AI | Cadre AI
claimsReviewed: Cadre publishes industry-specific offerings including professional services, private equity, real estate, financial services, mortgage/lending, construction, retail/e-commerce, manufacturing/logistics, and hospitality.

sources.title: Case Studies | AI Implementation Success Stories | Cadre AI
claimsReviewed: The public case-studies page is the approved destination for published client examples; no private-client facts are inferred beyond the page.

sources.title: Contact Cadre AI | AI Strategy & Implementation Partner
claimsReviewed: The official contact page is the safe handoff destination for strategist conversations, maturity-index requests, and account-specific questions.

sources.title: Privacy Policy
claimsReviewed: Cadre publishes a privacy policy for its own website and services; it is not automatically a privacy guarantee for this separately hosted candidate chatbot.
